proof:
# The standalone ordinary cap-profile inequality is false

This certificate concerns only an auxiliary scalar inequality, not OC.
It shows that proper cuts, actual section capacities, and
F<min(|A|,|T|) do not imply

    S+(8/3)F >= |A|+|T|.                           (1)

The full-triangle zero-endpoint closure remains valid: its actual
facet-extrusion step supplies information absent from (1).

Use the canonical normals v_1=(1,0), v_2=(0,1), v_3=(-1,-1),
the cap thresholds -1, and T={v_i.x<=1}, whose area is 9/2. Let

    P=(-3/2,-101/100),
    Q=(-3/2,-101/100-1/100000),
    R=(2,-9999/10000),
    A=conv{P,Q,R}.

All three cutting lines meet int A. The first two assertions follow
from the coordinate ranges. For the third, P and Q have coordinate
sums below one, while R has sum 10001/10000>1.

Put e=1/100000, tau=1/10000, eta=1/100, W=7/2. The area is

    a=We/2=7/400000.

The three section lengths divided by the corresponding normal norm
are, respectively,

    (6/7)e,
    W*tau*e/[(eta+tau)(eta+tau+e)],
    W*tau*e/[(35101/10000)(35101/10000+e)].

Each is strictly between zero and three (in fact each is less than
1/1000). Thus all three actual facet-capacity inequalities against
the full T facets are satisfied.

Let U_x,U_y,U_3 denote the captured A areas. Similar triangles at R
give

    U_x/a=36/49,
    U_y/a=tau^2/[(eta+tau)(eta+tau+e)]<1/10000,
    U_3/a=1-tau^2/[(35101/10000)(35101/10000+e)].

Their order is U_y<U_x<U_3. Accordingly

    F=U_y+U_x+U_3/4,
    F/a<1/10000+36/49+1/4<1.

Also F<a<9/2, so F<min(a,|T|). The support sum is exactly

    S=max_A x+max_A y+max_A(-x-y)=351011/100000.

Nevertheless

    S+(8/3)F-a-9/2
       < S+(5/3)a-9/2 <0.

The last inequality is exact rational arithmetic: S<3511/1000,
a<1/10000, and 3511/1000+1/6000<9/2. Hence (1) fails by a fixed
positive margin, not by a numerical rounding artifact.

The remaining true cap geometry explains why this is no threat to the
full triangular-endpoint proof. The largest A cap is the third one,
and its support height is h_3=251001/100000>2. Its actual extrusion
with the full B facet forces Q>(5U_3+9)/4 whenever it is used in the
three-fiber critical menu. That information is not encoded in (1).
